subject: CHEMISTRY
description: ICSE 10th Chemistry: Periodic Trends, Ionisation Energy, Electronegativity, Ionic, Covalent and Coordinate Bonds

questions.question: Across a period from left to right in the modern Periodic Table, atomic size generally:
questions.explanation: Nuclear charge increases across a period while number of shells remains constant, pulling electrons closer.

questions.question: Which element has the highest electronegativity in the entire Periodic Table?
questions.explanation: Fluorine has the highest electronegativity value (4.0 on Pauling scale).

questions.question: Which of the following compounds contains all three types of bonds: ionic, covalent, and coordinate?
questions.explanation: NH4Cl has covalent bonds (N-H), coordinate bond (N->H+), and an ionic bond between NH4+ and Cl-.

questions.question: What is the common name of the process used for industrial manufacture of Ammonia?
questions.explanation: Haber's process synthesizes ammonia from nitrogen and hydrogen gases using an iron catalyst.

questions.question: An aqueous solution of which gas turns moist red litmus paper blue?
questions.explanation: Ammonia is the only basic gas in the ICSE 10th syllabus that turns moist red litmus blue.
